import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the existing docs table
docs_table = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Create a computed column for embeddings using sentence-transformers UDF
docs_table.add_column(
    "content_embedding",
    docs_table.content.apply(
        pxt.builtins.sentence_transformers.embed,
        model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
    ),
    computed=True
)

# Create an index on the embedding column for nearest-neighbor lookups
docs_table.create_index("content_embedding_idx", column="content_embedding")

# Embed the search query
query_text = "climate change policy"
query_embedding = pxt.builtins.sentence_transformers.embed(
    query_text,
    model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"
)

# Perform semantic search to get 5 closest rows
results = docs_table.search(
    query_embedding,
    column="content_embedding",
    limit=5
)

# Display results ranked from closest to farthest
for rank, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{rank}. Distance: {row['_distance']:.4f}")
    print(f"   Content: {row['content']}\n")
